prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE large reusable illustrated SPADE suit pip for Celtic Design 3 playing cards. This is an isolated transparent component for ace and numeral-card layouts, NOT a card.
Input1 Celtic Queen is authoritative STYLE and ORNAMENT reference: hand-painted ink/gouache, dark woad-blue fields, warm bronze/gold interlace, oak leaves/acorns, earthy green and small red glass accents. Input2 Design2 spade supplies ONLY the unmistakable SPADE OUTLINE and isolated component construction; do NOT copy its lotus, flowers, teal foliage, gold beads or turquoise jewel.
Single upright conventional spade: pointed top, two rounded lower lobes, clean inward shoulders, short flared stem. Bilaterally balanced, smooth continuous contour, whole silhouette centered in a SQUARE canvas, generous clear transparent padding on all sides. True RGBA transparency OUTSIDE silhouette; fully opaque interior, no background or checkerboard drawn.
Main body charcoal-black with a subtle dark woad-blue cast: clearly a BLACK suit when small. A narrow double bronze/gold outline with a restrained Celtic interlace ribbon just inside the edge, readable broad dark spaces between ornaments. INSIDE ONLY: one compact circular bronze DOUBLE-SPIRAL ornament with TWO opposed coils near the middle (not triskele), paired olive-green oak leaves with acorns, a few flowing bronze spiral tendrils and two small red-glass bosses. Leaves have recognizable rounded oak lobes, not shamrocks. Keep ornament organized and relatively bold so pip reads at 100 pixels tall. The stem has one simple bronze interlace detail, not dangling flowers.
All ornament contained within the suit silhouette, clean strong edge. Same warm painted style as the Celtic courts, restrained shading, no shiny 3D emblem or photorealistic metal. Only ONE pip, no suits collage, no frame, no people, no letters, no A, no rank, no numerals, no external foliage, no shadow, glow, background, watermark, horns, runes, tartan, lotus, roses or jewel rosette. Return a genuinely transparent PNG.
